name: Topos
long_description: Topos is a neolab founded by two Harvard math dropouts, building agent swarms to bring the rigor and verifiability of mathematics to other fields. Starting in biology, we’re optimizing how agents communicate, formalize problems, and verify each other’s reasoning.

name: Agent Relay
long_description:
Agent Relay lets software teams' AI coding agents message each other directly, so people stop copy/pasting between Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and their teammates' agents. A frontend agent can ask the backend agent what an API returns, two agents can sort out a merge conflict between themselves, and your agent can answer a colleague's agent while you sleep.
 
Agents connect wherever they run: terminals, desktop apps, phones, laptops, cloud boxes, or a Mac mini across the world. Every session goes into shared, searchable history, so decisions don't get stuck in one person's chat. You can even let a customer's agent debug with yours. Setup takes about 5 minutes: give your agent the link and it installs itself. Use our hosted version free, or self-host the open-source version
one_liner: Let your teams' coding agents message each other

name: Halmos Labs
long_description:
Halmos Labs rebuilds the drug development infrastructure around agents. To prove the future, we are aiming to have our AI be the first to bring a drug to market, and have already brought a cancer vaccine, and a new antibiotic, to the lab with results expected in mid December. 

Physical validation is the main bottleneck of scientific research agents. Existing labs already have capacity, yet experiments remain difficult to access and coordinate. Halmos Labs plans experiments, and enables access to physical validation. Connecting to Halmos, every agent can close the loop on R&D without leaving the terminal.
one_liner: Rebuilding the drug discovery pipeline around agents

name: Acyclic Labs
long_description:
We’re building the foundations of agent swarms that can materially accelerate all work: benchmarks to measure model capabilities, models trained to coordinate thousands of agents, RL environments to improve them, and infrastructure that can put a datacenter’s worth of compute behind a single conversation within seconds.

Both founders graduated top 10% from Cambridge. Ram is a published ML researcher and Varun worked at the frontier of parallel programming languages and shipped enterprise multi-agent systems at Palantir and Tracelight. We realised that agents were good enough to solve most use cases. So why couldn’t we run thousands of them at once and finish hours of work in minutes?
one_liner: Benchmarks, RL envs and infra for scaling agent swarms

name: Adside.ai
long_description: We're Robin Choy and Guillaume Miara, founders of Adside (adside.ai). We're building Adside, a swarm of agents that manages ads on Meta, Google and LinkedIn, etc. We’re building the service we wished we had in our previous B2B marketing software company that we sold earlier this year.
one_liner: AI agency that manages paid ads on Meta, Google, LinkedIn, etc.
